sections.detail: Five complete noun paradigms: horse 10, house 8, elephant 6, girl 10, sister 10.
All personal, demonstrative, interrogative, relative and indefinite pronouns, with explicit Kului controls.
All adjective examples, eight correlative-series cells, eleven time adverbs, five place adverbs and six bound endings; three other-lect comparison units excluded.
Complete auxiliary, fall, become, come and go paradigms: 104 editorial units.
Complete beat, eat, drink, give and say paradigms: 56 editorial units.
Do, know, bring and take paradigms; full participle and auxiliary prose; two grammar examples; first twelve glossary lines.
Remaining twenty-two glossary lines and numbered sentences 1–17.
